rule_explanation: Invalid, corrupt, prematurely revealed, or unsealed oracle evidence cannot judge the tracer.
Missing manifests, lineage, parameters, independent units, or gate inputs block a quantitative verdict.
Authority, state, lineage, or determinism defects cannot be averaged away or narrowed by a weaker metric.
A narrower claim survives only when the sealed pre-reveal scope manifest, exact membership, and its required raw gate results independently pass.
Failure without a positive passing narrower scope requires redesign.
Scientific evaluation may pass while operational use remains blocked for optimization under Issue #128.
Every required gate and external operational dependency passes under the frozen scope.
Any state not matched above is invalid or incomplete and fails closed.
